heading: AI Agent
setupNotice: For first-time pairing, run Background-Agent.ps1 -Action Token locally and enter it in the trusted host. If already remembered, select Start using AI Agent.
features: No file or PowerShell permissions have been granted.
readOnlyNotice: Read-only output: send requests through ChatGPT MCP; this panel has no chat input.
setupSummary: Pair the Local Agent and authorize MCP to view operation status and output here.
setupIntro: Uses the existing Cluster PowerShell Local Agent. Download and pair the installer to begin.
downloadPackage: Download AI AGENT MCP plugin ZIP
guideStep1: Download the AI AGENT MCP(ChatGPT) plugin ZIP and load it from the local plugin manager.
guideStep2: Run Local Agent Quick-Setup.cmd and follow C/P/O port prompts; default port 43881.
guideStep3: Copy the Agent pairing token and selected port into the trusted host pairing dialog.
guideStep4: Use ToolBox to select a folder and separately approve Read, Create, Update, Delete and PowerShell.
guideStep5: Run MCP Quick-Setup.cmd to start MCP Gateway on 43880 and OAuth Gateway on 43879.
guideStep6: Set up a real public HTTPS hostname beginning with clusteropt2, valid TLS, and a proxy only to OAuth loopback 43879.
guideStep7: In ChatGPT, add a custom MCP server using the full HTTPS origin plus /mcp; complete OAuth.
guideStep8: cluster.read offers five read-only tools; cluster.control needs separate consent, and each PS command requires local approval.
